transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi... um, nice to meet you too. I guess I'm here because I'm just having a really hard time keeping things organized right now. 

Like, I have my schoolwork, and I also run this little accessories shop, and... I just can't seem to manage both at the same time. All my supplies, receipts, due dates, assignment notes... they just end up in these piles everywhere. I just look at it all and I don't really know what to do first.
Have you always struggled with this kind of disorganization, or is this something that has only started happening more recently?

Um... I guess it's more recent. It's been a real problem for... maybe two years and two months? Give or take. 

It kind of started when I changed schools. There was just... less structure, I guess. Trying to handle the business program and the shop at the same time without that structure... yeah, it just got really hard.
During these past two years, have you felt down, sad, or hopeless most of the time, more days than not?

Um... no. Not really. 

I mean, I get frustrated sometimes with all the mess, but... I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. Just... stressed, I guess.

When you feel stressed about your responsibilities, do you find that you spend a lot of time worrying about a wide range of other things in your life, such as your health, your finances, or your future, in a way that you find difficult to control?

Um... no, not really. 

I just... worry about getting the shop orders out and passing my classes. I don't really sit around worrying about all that other stuff. Just the things right in front of me that I'm messing up.
Looking back at your childhood, say before you were twelve years old, did you struggle with staying organized, finishing tasks, or keeping track of your belongings back then?

Um... I guess so. 

My mom actually... she still has some of my old notes from elementary school. The teachers used to write that I was... always getting out of my seat. And, um, talking before they called on me. 

They also said I would just... rush through group stuff. Even if I knew how to do the work. So... yeah. I guess it's been a while.
Do you find that you have these same difficulties with staying organized or finishing tasks in other areas of your life, like at home or in your personal relationships?

Um... yeah. I guess it affects other stuff, too. 

Like... I actually missed some required steps for my program recently. So... my financial aid is kind of at risk right now. And, um... the people I work with on shop projects... they've started depending on me less. Just... because of all this. So, yeah.
